caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and depicts a large tankard with a hinged lid, prominent handle, and a thumb lever at the top of the handle. The tankard, which appears metallic, is centered and shown in three-quarter view, with its surface smoothly shaded to suggest its cylindrical shape and metallic texture. The handle has decorative, curving elements, and the base features two horizontal ridges. There are two additional, smaller outlined views of the tankard: one in the upper right corner showing a side profile with the lid and thumb lever, and another in the lower left corner displaying a front view that emphasizes the handle's form and mechanism. All components are precisely sketched with attention to the object's structure and proportions. The background is plain and light, with a faint border drawn around the main image and inserts.
title: Silver Tankard
